body.description:
At least one field must be present. Lifecycle attribution
(`assigned_by`/`assigned_at`, `acknowledged_by`/`acknowledged_at`,
`resolved_by`/`resolved_at`) is not accepted here: the service records
the authenticated caller and the server time whenever `assignee_id`,
`acknowledged` or `status` changes.

status.description:
Setting `cleared` records the caller as the resolver; setting
`active` re-opens the alarm and clears the resolver.

assignee_id.description: Send an empty string to clear the assignee.

acknowledged.description:
`true` records the caller as the acknowledger, `false` clears the
acknowledgement.
